items.title: Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program
items.summary: OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了面向小企业的ChatGPT项目，旨在帮助创业者学习AI技能、实现工作流程自动化，并通过ChatGPT Work实现业务增长。原始信息显示：OpenAI launches the ChatGPT for Small Businesses program, helping entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate work, and grow with ChatGPT Work.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing the ChatGPT for small business program”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出面向小型企业的ChatGPT专属项目，推动大模型在中小微企业的普及落地。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
items.summary: We’re introducing new Gemini models, including Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.5 Flash Cyber.
items.summaryZh: 谷歌DeepMind发布了Gemini 3.6 Flash、3.5 Flash-Lite和3.5 Flash Cyber等新模型。3.6 Flash在编码、知识工作及多模态性能上表现出色，代币消耗显著降低；3.5 Flash-Lite提供了更高的性价比与吞吐量；3.5 Flash Cyber则结合CodeMender用于网络安全。同时，官方宣布已开始Gemini 4的预训练。

aiReview.reasonZh: 谷歌发布了包括Gemini 3.6 Flash在内的多款新模型，针对智能体工作流进行了高效率与低延迟优化。

items.title: OpenAI and Hugging Face partner to address security incident during model evaluation

items.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite: Halving Time per Task
items.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Both halve time per task relative to their predecessors and increase token efficiency, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite improves by 11 Intelligence Index points while Gemini 3.6 Flash does not improve in intelligence over 3.5 Flash

items.title: Kimi K3: second only to Fable 5 on AA-Briefcase
items.summary: Kimi K3 is second only to Fable 5 on AA-Briefcase, our agentic knowledge work benchmark, but costs more than Opus 4.8 to run while averaging nearly an hour per task

items.title: Grabette: an open system to record robot-manipulation data
items.summary: 来自原始信息源的最新动态，点击标题查看完整内容。
items.summaryZh: Grabette是一个开源且低成本的系统，用于记录机器人操作数据。它通过手持夹爪、摄像头和6-DoF轨迹恢复技术，允许用户无需真实机器人、实验室或复杂遥操作设备，即可在几分钟内收集并转化为机器人可用的数据集，旨在破解具身智能领域的数据供应难题。
